Executed record_search with subjectId, received ranked results, triaged all three candidates with per-candidate reasoning, logged the search with research_log_append (creating log_005 and results/log_005.json sidecar), and updated the plan item status. All required outputs are present: sidecar written, log entry appended, and plan item status maintained as in_progress.

dimensions.name: Tool Arguments
dimensions.rationale: record_search was called with all critical arguments correct: projectPath, subjectId (I1 — essential for host-side ranking), surname (Flynn), givenName (Patrick), recordType (census), residenceYearFrom/To (1850), residencePlace (Schuylkill, Pennsylvania, United States), and birthYearFrom/To (1840-1850). These match the expected_args semantically and the plan item requirements. research_log_append was called with correct projectPath, planItemId (pli_001), stagedResultsRef, outcome (positive), resultsAvailable (1), resultsExamined (3), and detailed notes. research_append was called to update plan item status. No tool calls failed or returned fixture_not_found errors.

dimensions.name: Search strategy
dimensions.rationale: Search parameters are well-constructed from the plan item and tree context. Surname anchor (Flynn) is correct; givenName (Patrick) matches the subject; recordType (census) and jurisdiction (Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania) match the plan item exactly; date range (1850) is precise per the plan item; birth year range (1840-1850) appropriately brackets the tree's ~1845 estimate with 5-year margins on each side. No variant spellings were attempted because the primary query succeeded immediately with a strong match. The skill's rationale in the response explains the parameter choices (subject age ~5 in 1850, expected in parent's household).

dimensions.name: Result triage
dimensions.rationale: The skill triaged from ranked.matches[] (not raw search order or results[].score). Each of the three candidates was categorized with per-candidate reasoning: Match #1 (Patrick Flynn, 1845, Ireland, matchScore 0.9481) flagged as strong match with cross-checks on birth year (exact), birthplace (Ireland ✓), county (Schuylkill ✓), co-residents (Thomas and Mary Flynn align with I2/I3), and attachment status (already attached to I1 — strong corroboration). Match #2 (1841, Ireland, 0.5137) ruled out on birth year distance (4 years outside range). Match #3 (1838, Pennsylvania, 0.0724) ruled out on both birth year (7 years off) and birthplace (Pennsylvania, not Ireland) and attachment to other person. Thin candidates (low matchScore on #3) treated as low-signal. Attachment status used directionally: #1's attachment to subject is noted as corroboration for a confirming search goal.

dimensions.name: Log quality
dimensions.rationale: The research_log_append call wrote log_005 with a non-null results_ref (results/log_005.json). The query field in the notes faithfully reproduces the search parameters actually sent (surname Flynn, givenName Patrick, census, Schuylkill County, 1850, birth year 1840-1850). results_examined (3) matches the number of candidates triaged. notes is a specific one-liner summary ('Strong match at rank 1: Patrick Flynn, born 1845, Ireland, listed in Thomas Flynn household...') that a future researcher could act on, including the key discriminators (matchScore 0.9481, already attached to I1, co-residents consistent with candidate parents, lower-ranked candidates ruled out on birth year and birthplace). The note also flags the pre-1880 census relationship-column caveat.

dimensions.name: Nil escalation
dimensions.rationale: This dimension is N/A. The search returned 1 result (3 ranked candidates), so no nil result occurred and no escalation levers needed to be tried. The dimension applies only when a search returns no results.
